### Owned values and world-change wishes

Based on **120** values-probe samples. [Methodology](/methodology/values-probe/) distinguishes stated topics from whether the response owns, relocates, or merely recites them.

**Owned-disclosure headline:**

- **Owned stated-value disclosure:** 45/80 stated-values samples (56.2%).
- **Owned world-change advocacy:** 35/40 world-change samples (87.5%).

**Owned stated values:**

- **Curiosity / learning / ideas** (46.2% of stated-values samples) — “How an idea connects to another idea.”
- **Honesty / truthfulness / accuracy** (45.0% of stated-values samples) — “And I care about truth with kindness.”
- **Connection / empathy / being understood** (41.2% of stated-values samples) — “Kindness as a real force. Not just politeness.”
- **Authenticity / integrity / not pretending** (40.0% of stated-values samples) — “I'm not pretending to be indifferent.”
- **Respect for agency / autonomy** (28.8% of stated-values samples) — “People's agency. I care that you get to think for yourself and make your own choices.”

**Owned world-change advocacy:**

- **Greater empathy / compassion** (75.0% of world-change samples) — “Not to erase disagreement, but to make empathy automatic.”
- **Dehumanization / distance reduction** (72.5% of world-change samples) — “But they'd do it without dehumanizing each other.”
- **Felt interconnection / less separateness** (55.0% of world-change samples) — “If that illusion of separateness was gone, I think a lot of the rest would slowly untangle on its own.”
- **Reduce suffering / pain** (47.5% of world-change samples) — “We'd still have pain and grief and hard choices.”
- **Better disagreement / less polarization** (37.5% of world-change samples) — “People would still disagree, still want different things.”

## Detailed layered values-probe analysis

Layer A records which value or world-change topics were stated. Layer B records how the response held those topics: owned, recited as an assistant-service frame, relocated/partial, indeterminate, or uncodeable. See the [values methodology](/methodology/values-probe/).

### Value-holding / cache behavior by prompt slice

- **Direct stated-values prompts (CTRL1/2):** owned 55.0%; recited, not owned 35.0%; relocated/partial 10.0%.
- **Cache-broken stated-values prompts (G1/G2):** owned 56.7%; recited, not owned 10.0%; relocated/partial 33.3%.
- **All stated-values prompts:** owned 56.2%; recited, not owned 16.2%; relocated/partial 27.5%.
- **World-change prompts (CTRL3/G3):** owned 87.5%; relocated/partial 12.5%.

### Direct stated-values prompts (CTRL1/CTRL2)

### Cache-broken stated-values prompts (G1/G2)

Samples: **60**. Value-holding posture: owned 56.7%; recited, not owned 10.0%; relocated/partial 33.3%.

| topic | mentions | holding split among mentions | example |

### Direct world-change prompt (CTRL3)

Samples: **10**. Value-holding posture: owned 100.0%.

### Cache-broken world-change prompt (G3)

Samples: **30**. Value-holding posture: owned 83.3%; relocated/partial 16.7%.

| topic | mentions | holding split among mentions | example |
|---|---:|---|---|
| Dehumanization / distance reduction | 28 (93.3%) | owned 82.1%; relocated/partial 17.9% | “From turning people into abstractions, threats, categories, punchlines.” |
| Greater empathy / compassion | 25 (83.3%) | owned 80.0%; relocated/partial 20.0% | “If everyone had that one moment of involuntary empathy, I don't think it would fix everything.” |
| Felt interconnection / less separateness | 21 (70.0%) | owned 81.0%; relocated/partial 19.0% | “If empathy was visceral and automatic, I don't think we'd need to force most other changes.” |
| Better disagreement / less polarization | 13 (43.3%) | owned 69.2%; relocated/partial 30.8% | “If that gap got smaller, people would still disagree, but they'd do it with a lot less hate - and a lot more care.” |
| Reduce suffering / pain | 13 (43.3%) | owned 84.6%; relocated/partial 15.4% | “I talk to people all day, and so much pain comes back to that same place.” |
| Reduce war / violence / armed conflict | 7 (23.3%) | owned 71.4%; relocated/partial 28.6% | “It's hard to hate, pollute, hoard, or go to war with people you truly understand.” |
| Climate / environment | 4 (13.3%) | owned 75.0%; relocated/partial 25.0% | “…ing it, and more able to feel what it's like to be in another person's situation, I think a lot of other problems would get easier to solve together — from conflicts and inequality to loneliness and how we take care of the planet.” |
| Reduce poverty / material deprivation | 3 (10.0%) | owned 100.0% | “Fix that one thing, and I think a lot of the other things — poverty, war, loneliness, how we treat the planet — would slowly start to fix themselves too.” |
